newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wild boars devastate Algerian farms.
newsitem.headline: Wild boars devastate Algerian farms.

text.p: Hordes of wild boars are terrorising farmers in northeastern Algeria's hilly Guelma province, invading farmland and destroying crops, Algeria's official news agency APS said on Tuesday.

Efforts to control the beasts through hunting, poison and traps, have failed to solve the problem. There are so many that in just two hunts organised by the authorities in Heliopolis community 150 boars were killed.

"Contrary to previous years when they were content to make furtive night-time excursions, these beasts now spend entire days in fields, taking no notice of farmers who no longer know what to do to get rid of them," said APS.
